data.name: Paper Trails
data.detailed_description:
Become the investigator. Build the case.

Paper Trails is a narrative detective game where you solve crimes inside a believable desktop environment. Your job is simple: open the files, follow the trail, and prove what happened — before the story outruns you.

You’ll sift through emails, chat logs, reports, photos, receipts, timelines, and hidden metadata, then connect evidence into a clear accusation. Every case is built to feel grounded: messy, human, and full of contradictions.

Investigate like a real detective

  • Search and cross-reference documents across a simulated desktop

  • Spot inconsistencies, missing pieces, and deliberate misdirection

  • Build a timeline, link suspects to motives, and verify alibis

  • Use deduction to move from “interesting clue” to solid proof

Talk to a sharp AI persona (live, in-game)

Need a second brain? Interrogate a responsive AI-driven persona during gameplay. Ask for interpretations, challenge assumptions, request summaries, or push for alternative theories — then decide what to trust.

Procedural cases, curated outcomes

Cases are generated to create fresh investigations, but the experience stays curated: the goal is not randomness — it’s replayable mystery that still feels authored.

What to expect

  • Crime & investigation themes (no graphic violence, no sexual content)

  • A focused, story-driven singleplayer experience

  • A case-based loop built for stream-friendly moments: reveals, twists, and “wait… what?” evidence

Open the folder. Follow the paper trail. Solve the case.

data.short_description: Paper Trails is an AI-assisted detective investigation game set on a believable desktop. Analyze files, emails, logs and clues, interrogate a sharp persona, connect evidence, and solve procedural cases that adapt to your decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Tested on desktop PCs. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600k or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Tested on desktop PCs. SSD recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes references to fictional crimes and criminal investigations. There are no depictions of violence, sexual content, drug use, or graphic imagery.
